recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future work should not reopen FHIR-23738 merely to re-copy 2020 branch text; any remaining concerns should be reconciled through narrower related Jira issues or newer R6 trackers.
issue_request: FHIR-23738 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I R5 change request used as a placeholder for the Argonaut-led Subscription redesign, especially aligning Subscription with a publish-subscribe pattern using SubscriptionTopic and filters.
initial_application: Early GF#23738 commits revised Subscription notes in 2019. The substantive application was merge commit 87b7ee84c2 for PR #848 from HL7/argonaut-subscription on 2020-04-27, explicitly labelled as Subscription R5 work for FHIR-23738 and introducing/updating Subscription, SubscriptionTopic, SubscriptionStatus, subscription-notification Bundle behavior, examples, and narrative.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes for 2020-04-27 record approval to merge the Subscription resources changes and list subscription.topic, Subscription.filterBy, channel flattening, SubscriptionTopic, subscription-notification Bundle, and SubscriptionStatus. Zulip discussion points reviewers to the same FHIR-23738 Argonaut branch. Later Published R5 ballot issues such as FHIR-39026 and FHIR-39028 refined the filter operator and trigger/filter timing details, so current source differences from the 2020 branch notes are approved evolution rather than missing seed work.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/fhir.ini actively includes Subscription, SubscriptionStatus, and SubscriptionTopic; Subscription.topic is a required canonical reference to SubscriptionTopic; Subscription.filterBy and SubscriptionTopic.trigger.canFilterBy express client filtering; SubscriptionStatus and subscription-notification Bundle rules are present.

related_jiras.note: The same Argonaut branch added the subscription-notification Bundle type and first-entry SubscriptionStatus rule.
The same branch documented SubscriptionTopic filter behavior; later R5 work refined the exact filter operator model.
The same branch changed channel modeling, including Subscription.channelType as Coding with an extensible binding.
Published R5 decision split filter operators into comparator and modifier, explaining current source shape.
Published R5 decision clarified SubscriptionTopic trigger and filter timing after the initial redesign.
Later R6 Resolved-change-required question about trigger criteria is not Applied/Published and was not reconciled here.
